description: This file contains functions for formatting test scripts' output in JUnit XML format, intended for integration with CI systems such as Azure Pipelines. It provides functions to start and finalize test output, handle individual test cases, and encode XML attributes.

methods.name: start_test_output
methods.description: Initializes JUnit XML output, creates directory, sets up XML headers.

methods.name: start_test_case_output
methods.description: Records the start time of a test case.

methods.name: finalize_test_case_output
methods.description: Finalizes the output for a single test case, including success, failure, skipped, or broken states, and embeds relevant messages or error outputs.

methods.name: finalize_test_output
methods.description: Closes the overall XML document, adjusting total test suite time.

methods.name: write_junit_xml
methods.description: Writes XML content to the designated file, handling truncation if needed.

methods.name: xml_attr_encode
methods.description: Encodes strings for safe inclusion as XML attributes.
